datasets.name: sales-by-month
datasets.description: Monthly revenue, units and target for four sales regions, January 2025 to December 2026, with Q4 seasonality and steady growth.

datasets.name: project-timeline
datasets.description: Fourteen tasks and milestones for a product launch, January to June 2026, with phases, owners, progress and finish-to-start dependencies.

datasets.name: survey-results
datasets.description: Five-level Likert responses to six statements, split by Customers (212 respondents) and Staff (94 respondents).

datasets.name: server-metrics
datasets.description: Five-minute samples from three hosts over 16 November 2026 (UTC): a daily load cycle, a 13:50-14:45 incident on web-01 and db-01, and five missed scrapes left as nulls.

datasets.name: population-by-region
datasets.description: Approximate 2024-25 population, land area and median age for forty countries across six world regions, with ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes and centroid coordinates.

datasets.name: budget-breakdown
datasets.description: Annual operating budget as a tree: five departments, two categories each, three line items per category (30 leaves, USD 18,775,000 total). Values sit on leaves only; parents are their sum.

datasets.name: budget-breakdown-flat
datasets.description: The budget-breakdown tree as flat id/parent rows (stratify-ready). value is set on the 30 line items and null on the root, departments and categories.

datasets.name: network-graph
datasets.description: A service dependency map for an online store: 30 services in four groups (edge, core, data, infra) and 61 directed calls weighted by requests per second.

datasets.name: org-tree
datasets.description: A 35-person company as id/parent rows: a CEO, four executives, ten managers and twenty individual contributors, four levels deep.

datasets.name: ohlc-prices
datasets.description: Daily open, high, low, close and volume for one fictional stock over 120 trading days from 1 June 2026 (weekends skipped, no holidays), from a seeded random walk.
